storySections.title: Basic Information
storySections.content:
Used flasks must be cleaned to look as good as new, tables burnt in experiments polished until they shine, and scales recalibrated every three days. Her fervor and respect for science and the mysteries of the world set high standards for everyone and everything around her.

Of course, these standards also apply to herself—after all, not everyone can calmly embrace death and willingly become an Awakener.

storySections.title: Story: I
storySections.content:
Doll is an indispensable figure at Mythag University and in the entire academic community. 

Among the Awakeners managed by the school, Doll is neither the most stable in gnostic index nor the strongest in combat abilities, but she is certainly the calmest and most rational one. 

For some Awakeners who were once human, the initial phase of "being reborn" is often accompanied by confusion, panic, and agitation. However, Doll seems unaffected by such "growing pains." 

On the second day after being awakened, she returned to the laboratory and compiled a technical manual that integrates outer domain knowledge and human wisdom within a year. 

Currently, Doll spends half her time innovating "silver chip technology" and the other half "cleaning up the mess for stupid students." 

— By the way, based on the influence of h-dim existence, Doll employed an unknown language in writing that "Technical Manual," and the translation work is being orderly conducted during her leisure time

storySections.title: Story: II
storySections.content:
"Unforgiving Critiques", "Low-scoring Test Papers", "Substandard Research Reports"

During Doll's decades of teaching career, few students obtained certificates from her. Most students were driven away by her overly harsh attitude and turned to other professors. Over time, Professor Doll's notorious reputation spread among the students.

But there are still students who believe she uses these standards to select "disciples". Only those with the strongest will deserve to hold the key to open the door of truth and follow her to unveil the reality of the world.

Supported by such a belief, even though the possibility of graduating under Doll is minuscule, applications for mentorship under Doll still continuously flood her office.

Sometimes, Ramona, who was temporarily called to review the applications, couldn't help but think that if the students believed this way, it wouldn't be so bad.

In Ramona's view, she merely held the standard of awakeners to demand human students, nothing more

storySections.title: Story: III
storySections.content:
Doll's joining is the only highlight of Mythag University in the eyes of the outside world.

Countless scholars lament that even a prodigy cannot escape the shackles of the mundane—she actually chose to be enrolled by an obscure university for wealth, tainted by the smell of copper.

While the outside world condemns her self-degradation, Doll has obtained something more precious than gold at Mythag University.

She has crossed the boundaries of material science, touching the veil of reality, beneath which lies something she would give her life to pursue.

Researching the dangers of "silver chip technology" is no less perilous than dancing on the edge of a blade, and Doll has become the most earnest, diligent, and excellent dancer.

When the D-mark appears, the scientific dancer does not cease her movement; instead, she spins within the limited time, either sedimenting or crystallizing her unique dance steps.

Until the D-phenomenon severely injures her physical body, spreading to her mind and eroding her rationality.

Even so, she remains far from the center of truth.

Thus, the flame of life has dimmed, leaving the brilliant star of knowledge with this farewell: "Awake me before the world forgets me."

storySections.title: Story: IV
storySections.content:
A new star of science and knowledge rises in an ordinary worker's family.

Most of Doll's childhood was filled with the sounds of cylinder throbs and gear operations.

But a love for machinery was not enough to support the girl in climbing the rugged and steep mountain of science.

What led her onto the path of knowledge was a plague.

An unknown madness raged through the city; hospitals were overcrowded, the morgue was overwhelmed, and everyone was on edge.

"The city's graveyards aren't enough—dig up grandma or burn mom, you have to choose one."

Thus, Doll watched her mother disappear into the flames.

Unlike others who were cremated, among the fragments and ashes she once called "mother," there flowed a shimmering silver mass.

"I want to know if I can see her again."

"I want to know if her kind soul is inside that."

"I want to know if that silver substance is the genesis of life, if it is the essence of the soul."

"I want to know if everything in this world has a common starting point."

Before getting the answers, Doll will not bow to the D-phenomenon.

daily.title: Awaken
daily.content: You'd better prove yourself worthy of making me leave the lab, new Keeper.

daily.title: Upgrade: I
daily.content: The conversion rate is far too low. Report to my office tomorrow for retraining.

daily.title: Upgrade: II
daily.content: Not bad, I guess.

daily.title: Upgrade: III
daily.content: My joint movement has notably improved.

daily.title: Enlighten: Observe
daily.content: Has my body or my consciousness improved? An intriguing subject for analysis.

daily.title: Enlighten: Ponder
daily.content: My mind feels sharper; not bad at all.

daily.title: Enlighten: Reflect
daily.content: Balancing attendance, maintaining research progress, and completing teaching tasks. It seems the reverse time compression experiment requires immediate prioritization.

daily.title: Enlighten: Insight
daily.content: I much prefer lab work to field duty—did you truly believe those assist tools simply materialized from the sea?

daily.title: Enlighten: Elevate
daily.content: The will I've merged with is quite boisterous; the higher I ascend, the clearer His voice becomes... like the geese in Hyde Park, perpetually clamoring.

daily.title: Enlighten: Florish
daily.content: This body can barely contain this Power, but it's not yet time to switch puppets. Why are you merely standing there? Assist me with this leg; adjustments are required.

daily.title: Affinity: I
daily.content: Thirteen reports require urgent approval, six damaged communicators await repair, and I must also monitor the results of five distinct Silver extraction experiments... So, instead of squandering my limited time by disturbing me, why not attempt to exercise your feeble brain matter?

daily.title: Affinity: II
daily.content: Do I always appear busy? Yes. Assistants can occasionally be useful, but in some research, I am simply irreplaceable. Do you wish to help? Then periodically check if I am still, in fact, alive.

daily.title: Affinity: III
daily.content: I look angry? Do you comprehend how many muscles are required for a smile? I once elucidated this in class, a lesson that evidently slipped from your smooth brain. The answer is a minimum of seventeen, and I possess no logical reason to be angry with you.

daily.title: Affinity: IV
daily.content: "It was the secrets of heaven and earth that I desired to learn. I wanted to figure out what force is controlling me?" ...Though I find this novel's plot unsatisfying and its fictional science laughably naive, after reading it, you should grasp my motivations... Wait, you haven't read this book?

daily.title: Affinity: V
daily.content: I have no time for rest. The Dissolution has already claimed two of my bodies. Before the inevitable end catches up, there is much I must comprehend... Assist me, starting with the preparation of experimental materials. I trust you won't miscalculate the balance.

daily.title: Chat: Touch
daily.content: Your feeble brain appears incapable of retaining lessons.

daily.title: Chat: About Afternoon Tea
daily.content: Awakeners might consume out of curiosity, but food is not essential for our existence. Therefore, there is no need to summon me for every afternoon tea. Sugar intake only accelerates the wear and tear on this body's ball joints.

daily.title: Chat: About Winkle
daily.content: Winkle's native species can infiltrate the biological brain, causing the Outer Will fused with me to fear her. But now, she's merely a poor soul confined within a shell.

daily.title: Chat: About Erica
daily.content: I sincerely hope she doesn't malfunction during our conversation. My lovely yet infuriating assistant, there are no more spare labs for her to inadvertently detonate.

daily.title: Chat: About Dissolution
daily.content: Since its first clear documentation, the Dissolution has impacted over a million lives. Our actions are critical to the survival of the entire human population.

daily.title: Chat: About Mythag
daily.content: I joined Mythag at the age of fourteen. Had I graduated smoothly, you would be addressing me as Principal now.

daily.title: Chat: What I Like
daily.content: My hobbies include trying to solve the Riemann Hypothesis—that, however, is our Mr. Peacock's catchphrase, not mine. Personally, I find atomic mass standards far more engaging.

daily.title: Chat: What I Hate
daily.content: Things I despise... a disorganized desk, a messy wardrobe, dusty window sills—yes, I am describing your room. By 7 AM tomorrow, I expect it restored to its pre-occupancy state.

daily.title: Chat: About the Keeper
daily.content: I hope you won't squander your potential and humanity's expectations, new Keeper.

battle.title: Investigation Begins
battle.content: I hope your command won't disappoint.

battle.title: Investigation Success
battle.content: Keep it up! Your final grades are promising.

battle.title: Investigation Halted
battle.content: Should this occur again, I'll be applying for your disciplinary probation.

battle.title: Rouse
battle.content: The truth... it's revealed right here.

battle.title: Exalt
battle.content: Unveil the world's mysteries with human intellect!

battle.title: Over-Exalt
battle.content: Next, we dissect the world's essence!
